name: Double Threat Setup (Fork in One)
description: P0 to move. Playing col 3 creates a fork: (a) horizontal 3-in-a-row at row 5 cols 1-3 needs col 4, and (b) vertical 3-in-a-row at col 1 rows 3-5 needs row 2. P1 can only block one. Tests whether the evaluator sees multi-move tactics at depth >= 2.
